title: Make historical render fixtures independent of the platform default
detail: Keep historical DAWN interaction and golden-render assertions explicit about their renderer while resolver tests continue to judge platform defaults. Exercise the Frequency public venue privacy boundary with inert join-door reads and complete category exports. Compare receipt delivery paths with identical rotating artwork. No assertions, snapshots, timeouts or production code are weakened. Affected suites passed 198 assertions; focused public privacy tests passed 3 assertions.

verify.note: Renders the actual RowCard under both designs and verifies destination, title and design-specific markup without a nested test runner.
